login.title: Sign in to SliceDock

setup.title: Set up SliceDock
setup.memoryWarning: This container is limited to {limit}. Slicing needs more than 1 GB; 2 GB or more is recommended. Restart the container with a higher --memory value before slicing large models.
setup.lan.title: Complete setup from your local network
setup.lan.text: For your security, the first-time setup only works when you open SliceDock directly on your local network — for example http://192.168.1.50:3000 — and not through a domain, tunnel or reverse proxy.
setup.lan.why: Until an admin account exists, anyone who can reach this page could claim the server. Blocking requests that come through a proxy or a public hostname keeps that window closed to the internet.
setup.lan.howTo: Open this page from a device on the same network as the server, using its local IP address, then come back here once you are done.
setup.welcome.title: Welcome to SliceDock
setup.welcome.text: Let's get your printer panel ready. This takes about two minutes: you will create the admin account, add your printer, choose how SliceDock is reached and pick a slicer engine.
setup.welcome.languageHint: You can change it later from your account.
setup.admin.title: Create the admin account
setup.admin.text: This account manages users, printers and settings.
setup.admin.emailHint: Used as the contact address for push notifications (the VAPID subject) and as the admin contact. It is never shared.
setup.printer.title: Add your printer
setup.printer.text: SliceDock only reads information during this test — it never sends commands to the printer.
setup.printer.notTested: You have not tested the connection yet. You can continue and test it later from Admin → Printers.
printer.name: Name
printer.hostHint: Shown on the printer screen under Settings → Network.
printer.staticIpHint: Turn off if your router may give the printer a different IP address.
printer.macHint: Used to find the printer again when its IP address changes. Testing the connection fills it in automatically.
printer.dynamicWarningTitle: Dynamic IP discovery requires host networking
printer.dynamicWarning: To find the printer by its MAC address, SliceDock scans your local network. That only works when the container runs with --network host (or on a network that can reach your LAN).
printer.hostNetworkYes: Host networking detected — discovery should work.
printer.hostNetworkNo: Host networking not detected — discovery will probably fail. Use a static IP or restart the container with --network host.
printer.macFilled: MAC address filled in from the printer.
printer.liveSoon: Live status (temperatures, progress, camera) is coming in Phase 2.
exposure.title: How will you reach SliceDock?
exposure.text: This tells SliceDock how to find the real IP address of each visitor, which matters for login rate limits, bans and the audit log.
exposure.noneDesc: Open SliceDock directly by IP on your LAN. No proxy headers are trusted.
exposure.cloudflareDesc: cloudflared runs on your network. The visitor IP comes from the CF-Connecting-IP header.
exposure.nginxDesc: A reverse proxy on your network. The visitor IP comes from X-Real-IP or X-Forwarded-For.
exposure.otherDesc: Traefik, Caddy, HAProxy… X-Forwarded-For is read from trusted proxies (private ranges by default; adjust them in Admin → Settings).
exposure.publicUrlHint: The address people use from outside, e.g. https://print.example.com.
exposure.httpsNote: HTTPS is required for push notifications on iPhone and iPad (installed as an app from Safari).
exposure.trustedProxiesHint: One IP address or CIDR range per line. Leave empty to trust private ranges.
engine.title: Choose the slicer engine
engine.text: The engine turns 3D models into G-code on the server. The editor and 3D preview run in your browser.
engine.crealityDesc: Official Creality profiles for the K2 SE and the best support for CFS multi-color. Produces the same G-code as the Creality app.
engine.orcaDesc: Excellent calibration tools and quicker upstream updates. CFS support is partial.
engine.autoUpdateHint: Checks for new engine releases in the background. You can always update manually from Admin → Slicer engine.
summary.title: Review and finish
summary.text: Check that everything looks right. You can change all of this later in the admin panel.
